create.name: Garchen Buddhist Institute
create.bio:
The Garchen Buddhist Institute is a Drikung Kagyu retreat and teaching centre on ninety-five acres of forested hills above Chino Valley, near Prescott in Arizona, bordering the Prescott National Forest and looking out towards Sedona's red cliffs and the San Francisco Peaks. It was created by His Eminence Garchen Rinpoche, a Tibetan master of the Drikung Kagyu school of Vajrayana Buddhism, as a place where students of every level can study, practise and go into retreat. Its resident teacher is Khenpo Tenzin, trained at Gargon Monastery, Sertar and Sera Jey, and lamas such as Lopon Thupten Nima and Drupon Rinchen Dorjee teach there regularly; Drupon Rinchen Dorjee also guides its three-year retreat.

The institute runs a full yearly calendar of group retreats, ritual practice gatherings and teachings, many streamed free online, from week-long drupchens to a New Year retreat on Chenrezig and Mahamudra. Every week Khenpo Tenzin leads a free mindfulness meditation session and Sunday Dharma teachings and discussion, and an online preliminary-practice programme guides students through the ngöndro over the year. Practitioners can also arrange short or long solitary retreats in its cabins, and the site keeps an online library of practice texts. Its YouTube channel holds thousands of recorded teachings and practices.

courses.title: 2026-2027 Winter Event: Mani Drubcho and Mahamudra
courses.description: A week bringing in the New Year with three days of group Chenrezig practice followed by teachings and guided meditation on Mahamudra with Drupon Rinchen Dorjee and Khenpo Tenzin. Attend in person in Chino Valley, or join online, where the programme is free; registration opens on 23 November.

courses.title: Personal solitary retreats
courses.description: Short-term and long-term solitary retreats in silence at the institute, for practitioners accepted after an application to the office. Newcomers are encouraged to attend a group retreat first; retreat guidelines and an agreement are provided.

free_resources.title: Weekly meditation with Khenpo Tenzin
free_resources.description: A free hour of meditation instruction and practice with the institute's resident teacher on Sunday mornings, open to everyone in person or online.

free_resources.title: Online library of practice texts
free_resources.description: An index of practice texts and other materials used at the institute's teachings and retreats, free to view or download.
